summary: Phase 1 tested end-to-end: auth (JWT and bcrypt, cookies, lockout), signup validation, demo login and View as, the RBAC matrix for all 4 demo roles, overview and usage data integrity across the 7/30/90 day ranges, OpenAPI, seed idempotency across a backend restart, and UI journeys JRN-1 to JRN-18 on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Backend: 29/29 pytest pass. Frontend: every tested journey passed. No functional bugs found; a few minor design and copy notes are listed below.

minor.issue: Stateless JWT. Logout only clears cookies, so a Bearer access token stays valid for up to 60 minutes after logout. There is no server-side revocation.
data['email'] is read without a guard. If the Emergent payload has no email, this raises KeyError and returns 500.

issues: ChatGPT (#10A37F) and Perplexity (#0D9488) are almost the same green-teal and hard to tell apart in the donut and stacked area charts
The 'Spend by department' card stretches to match the height of the Allocation health card, leaving a large empty area under the bar chart
The Top provider card subtitle shows overall avg credits/day, not anything about the top provider
X-axis label for Sofia Marchetti shows only 'Sofia' while the others show full names
The Provider breakdown table clips the Share column inside the card (it scrolls inside the card, the page itself does not overflow)

action_items: Optional: give Perplexity (or ChatGPT) a clearly different colour
Optional: guard the missing email in google_session (return 401 instead of 500)
Optional copy fixes: 'Individual · Individual' chip, 'Welcome back' for new users
critical_code_review_comments: The RBAC matrix in core/permissions.py is centralised and the backend enforces it everywhere. require_org correctly blocks Individual accounts from /api/org.
demo_switch correctly requires both the current user and the target to be is_demo.

The seed is idempotent ($setOnInsert, keyed by id) and never rewrites the hashes of existing demo users. The usage seed re-runs once per day to add new days. Old records beyond 90 days are kept, which is harmless.
CORS uses explicit origins with credentials. A foreign Origin gets no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.
members_usage loads all departments without an org filter (db.departments.find({})). This works now but should be scoped by org_id for multi-tenant safety.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Test users (TEST_User / TEST_UI User, plus 2 TEST_Org orgs) were created through register and then deleted by id, together with their allocations and audit_log entries. After cleanup: users=16, orgs=1, usage_records=4958.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: the demo accounts (password Demo@12345) all work.
